title: Create: Gunsmithing Renewable Lead
description: A simple datapack to get renewable lead in Create: Gunsmithing addon!
body:
A simple datapack that adds recipes to get renewable lead in [Create: Gunsmithing](https://modrinth.com/mod/cgs) addon!

## ⚙️ What this datapack adds:
- Basalt Grinding Recipe that yields 80% chance to get a Lead Nugget and 15% chance to get an Experience Nugget
- Cobbled Deepslate Grinding Recipe that yields one Gravel and 15% chance to get a Lead Nugget
